headline: Bitcoin slid below $69,000 overnight as more than $1.4B of leveraged bets were force-closed, with US producer prices due at 8:30am ET (20:30 Bangkok) tonight.

market.asOf: Read about 07:58-08:01 UTC Fri 13 Nov (15:00 Bangkok; 3am ET) from CoinGecko's BTC, ETH and SOL pages. Use the live prices on this page.

stories.title: Bitcoin slides below $69,000 as forced selling grows
stories.summary: Bitcoin kept falling overnight and dropped below $69,000, its lowest level since 20 August, per The Block. Ether is below $2,000 for the first time since August, per CoinDesk. Much of the drop came from forced selling: traders who borrowed to bet on rising prices had their positions closed automatically by exchanges as prices fell, which added to the selling. CoinDesk links the slide to a stronger US dollar, higher odds of a Fed rate hike, and renewed Middle East tension.
points: Bitcoin was down 7% in 24 hours at $68,408 as of 12:10am ET, per The Block.
$1.47B of leveraged bets were force-closed in 24 hours, $1.31B of them bets on rising prices, per CoinGlass data cited by The Block; CoinDesk gives more than $1.3B.
The lowest price was $67,500 on Bitstamp, per Bitcoin.com, and $67,922 on CoinGecko data, per CryptoTicker.
Bitcoin is down about 17% for the quarter, and the US Dollar Index is above 103, its highest since April 2025, per CoinDesk.
Prices were read at about 3am ET; use the live prices on this page for the current level.

stories.title: US producer prices tonight, with a December rate hike already expected
stories.summary: The October producer price index (PPI), a measure of inflation at the wholesale level, comes out at 8:30am ET (20:30 Bangkok), per the Bureau of Labor Statistics. It follows a hotter-than-expected consumer inflation report this week. Traders already expect the Fed to raise rates in December. Higher rates make savings and bonds pay more, which tends to pull money away from risky assets like crypto. Separately, Iran's Revolutionary Guards said they targeted a US radar in Bahrain; the US and Bahrain had not commented, per Reuters via Investing.com.
points: Economists expect PPI to rise 0.4% on the month (prior +1.3%) and core PPI 0.3% (prior +0.7%), per Finviz and TD Economics.
On a yearly basis, consensus is 6.6% (prior 6.3%), per Finviz.
Newsquawk says a quarter-point hike is about fully priced for December, with roughly a 10% chance of a half-point move.
October consumer prices rose 0.4% against 0.3% expected, and core 0.3% against 0.2%, per Newsquawk.

sources.label: Investing.com (Reuters): Iran's Guards and Bahrain radar

stories.title: Nvidia CEO exit, Strategy's MSCI removal and ETF outflows weigh on crypto
stories.summary: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia's CEO, with CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO, per TechCrunch; Nvidia's Q3 results are still set for 17 November. Index provider MSCI will remove Strategy (MSTR), a company that holds large amounts of bitcoin, from its indexes after the 30 November close, which can bring selling from funds that track those indexes. Money also kept leaving US bitcoin funds.
points: Harvey Jones was named Nvidia's first board chair, per TechCrunch.
Strategy shares fell 6.49% on Thursday to close at $114.41; MSCI-linked funds hold about 13M shares, or 3.1% of basic shares outstanding, per Cointelegraph.
Metaplanet is also being removed from the MSCI Japan Small Cap Index, per The Block.
US spot bitcoin ETFs lost about $300M on Wednesday, $270M of it from BlackRock's IBIT, and ether ETFs lost $145M, per crypto.news.

sources.label: Cointelegraph via TradingView: Strategy stock and MSCI

briefs.title: Trump names new SEC and CFTC nominees
briefs.summary: Trump sent four nominees to the Senate: Kristin Johnson and Steven Levine for the SEC, and Nathan Anonick and Matthew Rowland for the CFTC, which currently has one commissioner, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Thursday bitcoin ETF flows partly in
briefs.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs showed $47.7M of net outflows on Thursday before BlackRock's and Fidelity's figures were reported, per Bitcoin Haber.

briefs.title: TRM Labs launches tool to freeze stolen crypto faster
briefs.summary: TRM's Beacon Concierge has helped freeze more than $35M across 15 cases with 14 agencies; DefiLlama counts $8.78B lost to 341 hacks this year, per The Block.

briefs.title: US moves to seize $1.2B stolen in the Binance hack
briefs.summary: A court approved seizing or holding more than $1.2B tied to October's Binance hack, part of more than $2.7B frozen so far, per The Block.

briefs.title: SEC backs CFTC in stock perpetual futures case
briefs.summary: The SEC filed a court brief supporting the CFTC in a case brought by the Capital Markets Alliance over stock perpetual futures, per The Block.

briefs.title: Tron, Tether and Chainalysis form a crime task force
briefs.summary: The new Digital Crime Task Force will work to freeze illicit USDT on Tron; it follows the dissolution of the earlier T3 unit, per The Block.

briefs.title: Stablecoin supply shrinks fastest since 2022
briefs.summary: Stablecoin supply fell $14.2B in the 30 days to 9 November, the biggest drop since June 2022, per Glassnode data reported by crypto.news.

briefs.title: Louisiana sues 10 prediction-market platforms
briefs.summary: Louisiana's Attorney General sued Kalshi, Robinhood, Polymarket, Crypto.com, Coinbase, Gemini and four others under state law, per The Block.
